paragraphs: In the morning, review geological models and lay out mining areas and ore grades. At midday, align ground-support and ventilation parameters with field teams. In the afternoon, go underground to inspect safety and progress. In the evening, review hazard remediation, then complete a final environmental and compliance check before design approval.

In short, they safely extract underground mineral resources. They design operations, specify ground support, plan capacity, verify safety, inspect underground sites, and write plans. Combining analysis with underground work, they uphold the mine's safety baseline.
